summary: Thin wrapper around the Win32 IsBadWritePtr import (thunk at 0x0059E09C). Calls IsBadWritePtr(lp, ucb) and returns the logical negation of its result: BOOL TRUE when the range is readable/writable (IsBadWritePtr returned zero), FALSE when it is not. The imported function reports whether a caller has write access to a memory range, so this wrapper is a positive writable-check predicate. Called by sub_5939F9 (0x005939F9).

local_names.IsBadWritePtr: imported Win32 API; nonzero return means the range is not writable
